Hotfix 11 makes D3D11 first-frame presentation fail open and delays DLSS 5 startup until Present is healthy. Hotfix 10 native UNCANNY pass-stack routing and ELYSIUM advanced-control wiring remain intact.

The corrected public package excludes internal test/diagnostic executables. Microsoft Defender scanned the cleaned runtime tree and completed ZIP after signature update: 0 detections. Engine 1.1.26080.3, signatures 1.459.256.0, product 4.18.26080.3. No AV exclusions or bypass were used.

Full development source is private; public releases are compiled/source-free packages.
